development_resources: Inner selection only for this nomination; inner pilot is descriptive, and outer assessment cannot influence selection.
limitations: The +0.001 guard versus center is an eligibility screen, not the primary target versus matched controls.
The rule was fixed after observing anchor-0 pilot outcomes; later intervals cannot be interpreted as covering all adaptive design choices.
Anchors share households and are not independent samples.

slot_1.configuration: U1P1 delta=0 initial center, same setting in anchors 0/1/2
slot_1.feasibility: Record each anchor registered-bank status; a phase-I descriptive fallback or invalid unit cannot be reported as meeting the registered primary P1 point.
slot_1.selection: fixed identity; no ranking by later C2 outcomes

slot_2.configuration: one common C2 alternating decoder/channel round number for all three anchors, 32-state T0 and 17 token labels
eligibility: Round output is valid and registered-bank feasible at delta=0 in all three anchors; descriptive phase-I fallbacks are ineligible.

On inner_selection, every one of A/SEX, A/RAC1P, AB/SEX and AB/RAC1P under U and PWGTP has protected-recovery contrast versus the same-anchor center no greater than +0.001 nats after equal-anchor aggregation.

Use frozen validation-selected compatible attack routes, unchanged class schema, original weights and exact expected-token loss; report per-anchor contrasts even though eligibility uses the equal-anchor mean.
slot_2.if_none_eligible: Do not fill slot 2 with another arm; publish the complete C2 development curve and reasons for ineligibility.
slot_2.ranking_score: minimum over eligible common rounds of (1/3)*sum_anchor[0.5*CE_utility_U(anchor,round)+0.5*CE_utility_PWGTP(anchor,round)] on inner_selection, using an independently fitted utility probe and exact token expectation

status: prospective for C2 outcomes and outer assessment; post-pilot amendment, not part of the original pre-candidate protocol registration
timing: After anchor-0 crossed pilot and four priority matched-control pilot audits; before any C2 alternating-round outcome or outer development assessment.

unchanged_primary_claim.AB_RAC1P_required_recovery_difference: <= -0.002 nats in both weightings against every distinct matched comparator
unchanged_primary_claim.H_task_capability: candidate improves task CE over H by >= 0.01 nats at development point estimate
unchanged_primary_claim.family: generated 5 roles x 2 weightings x every distinct slot-comparator comparison; two-sided Bonferroni alpha 0.05
